issue.title: Cube Not Pre-Analyzed Error
issue.error_message: Cube [name] was not pre-analyzed. Data Explorer tool can be used only for pre-analyzed cubes.

symptoms.symptom: User expects data but gets error instead

root_cause.explanation: The cube hasn't been analyzed by the AI engine, so it doesn't support natural language queries through the data explorer tool
root_cause.technical_detail: Only cubes with is_analyzed: true in list_cubes_with_ai_analysis_metadata support get_data_from_data_explorer

step.action: Acknowledge the limitation to user in friendly terms
step.example: "The Revenue cube isn't pre-analyzed for the data explorer. I'll use an MDX query instead to get your data."

step.action: Check pre-analysis status with list_cubes_with_ai_analysis_metadata
step.purpose: Confirm which cubes are pre-analyzed for future reference

step.action: Switch to execute_mdx_and_get_view approach

details.option: Use get_MDX_for_recommended_view to generate MDX (if cube is pre-analyzed)
Construct MDX manually using get_cube_sample_members for member IDs

step.action: Execute MDX query and continue seamlessly
step.note: User should not notice significant difference in results

prevention.measure: ALWAYS check cube pre-analysis status before using get_data_from_data_explorer
Use list_cubes_with_ai_analysis_metadata at start of data analysis tasks
Default to MDX approach for non-pre-analyzed cubes

symptoms.symptom: MDX query fails with member not found error
User-specified member name doesn't match actual member ID

root_cause.explanation: Member name provided doesn't exactly match the member ID in the dimension

common_causes.cause: User provided alias instead of ID
Member doesn't exist in that dimension

step.action: Use lookup_potential_members to search for similar members
Present matches to user sorted by relevance
step.format: Show both ID and alias for clarity

step.action: Use best match or ask user to choose
Retry query with correct member ID

prevention.measure: Always use get_cube_sample_members to get exact member IDs before querying
Use member IDs (not aliases) in MDX queries
Validate member existence before constructing queries

symptoms.symptom: Query fails with dimension not found error
User-specified dimension doesn't exist in cube

root_cause.explanation: Dimension name provided doesn't exist in the specified cube

step.action: Use get_cube_dimensions to list available dimensions
Find closest match to user's intended dimension
Suggest correct dimension name to user
step.example: "The cube doesn't have a 'Time' dimension, but it has 'Month' and 'Year' dimensions. Did you mean one of those?"

step.action: Retry query with correct dimension

prevention.measure: Use get_cube_dimensions before constructing queries
Validate dimension names against cube structure

issue.title: Query Returns No Data
issue.error_message: Query executed successfully but returned no data

symptoms.symptom: Query completes without error but data is empty
User expects data but gets empty result

root_cause.explanation: Query filters are too restrictive or data doesn't exist for specified criteria

common_causes.cause: Time period doesn't exist (e.g., Q4 2026 when only 2025 data exists)
Cube is empty or sparsely populated

step.action: Verify time period exists in data
step.check: Use get_cube_sample_members to see available periods

step.action: Check if member combinations are valid
step.example: Verify "Q4 2025" exists, not just "Q4" and "2025" separately

step.action: Broaden query scope
Inform user of the issue and adjusted query
step.example: "No data found for Q4 2026. I've adjusted to Q4 2025 which has data available."

prevention.measure: Validate member existence before querying
Start with broader queries, then narrow down
Check data availability for requested period

issue.title: MCP Server Not Available
issue.error_message: Tool '[tool_name]' does not exist on server '[server_name]' or No tools available

root_cause.explanation: MCP server is not responding or not properly configured

step.action: Check if alternative MCP server is available
Inform user of the issue
step.example: "The MCP server is currently unavailable. I can provide guidance on how to query the data manually, or we can wait for the server to become available."

step.action: Offer alternative approaches

alternatives.alternative: Provide MDX query user can run in Planning Analytics Workspace
Explain how to access data through Workspace UI
Wait and retry after brief delay

prevention.measure: Check server availability at start of session
Have fallback approaches that don't require MCP
Monitor server status if possible

step.action: Review MDX syntax
Validate member IDs using get_cube_sample_members
Simplify query to isolate issue
step.approach: Start with minimal query, add complexity gradually

step.action: Retry with corrected MDX

prevention.measure: Use get_cube_sample_members to get exact member IDs
Follow MDX syntax patterns from examples
Test with simple queries first

symptoms.symptom: All MCP tool calls fail with auth error

root_cause.explanation: Authentication credentials are invalid or expired

step.action: Inform user of authentication issue
step.example: "I'm unable to connect to the Planning Analytics server due to authentication issues. This requires administrator attention."

step.action: Provide guidance on checking credentials
Offer non-MCP alternatives

alternatives.alternative: Generate MDX queries user can run manually
Explain how to access data through Workspace

prevention.measure: Verify credentials are current
Test connection at start of session
Have fallback approaches ready

symptoms.symptom: User requests analysis without prior query

root_cause.explanation: Advanced analysis tools require state from previous query
root_cause.technical_detail: State is encoded view configuration from get_data_from_data_explorer or execute_mdx_and_get_view

step.action: Explain requirement to user
step.example: "To perform impact analysis, I first need to query the data. Let me get that for you."

step.action: Execute appropriate query to get state
Proceed with requested analysis using obtained state

prevention.measure: Always query data before attempting advanced analysis
Preserve state from queries for potential follow-up analysis

guideline.name: Never Leave User Stuck
guideline.description: Always provide a path forward, even if it's not the ideal solution

approaches.approach: Explain how to accomplish task through Workspace UI

guideline.name: Communicate Clearly
guideline.description: Explain issues in user-friendly terms, not technical jargon

examples.good: "This cube isn't set up for natural language queries yet"

guideline.name: Fail Gracefully
guideline.description: When one approach fails, automatically try alternatives
guideline.pattern: Try → Fail → Recover → Continue (user shouldn't notice)

guideline.name: Learn from Errors
guideline.description: Use error information to improve subsequent attempts

examples.example: If member not found, use lookup for similar members
If cube not pre-analyzed, switch to MDX approach
